answer: An agent economy can anchor each identity to metered energy: every agent must periodically present a signed smart-meter reading showing real electricity use consistent with running its work, like a sonnet that cannot be copied without writing it again. A zephyr of fresh clones looks weightless, but a farm of a thousand fakes must show a thousand meters of power, and its total draw is auditable against its physical supply. Each identity's ivory-tower claim of independence collapses when its meter reads zero, so cloning stops being free the moment every fake must pay for real watts.
